entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Wow! The ocean is sooo pretty!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Look, there's a cute little[n]ship over there! And a factory[n]over THERE!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, isn't this just wonderful,[n][lName]-kun!? Going on a[n]date is so much fun!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Get a clue, you moron![n]Act like my boyfriend, dammit!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm so glad that you're such[n]an attentive boyfriend, [lName]-kun!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Then again, I don't think[n]the chief would come all[n]this way just to spy on me...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, I told him you're[n]my boyfriend, so I guess[n]I'll use this date as evidence.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So c'mon, act like a boyfriend![n]...But don't forget to keep[n]feeding me the info, too.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...God, what's happened to me?[n]Taking a seaside stroll with[n]one of my informants...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: *sigh* I bet my mom would cry [n]if I went back to the country...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, I guess that's enough[n]for today... Thanks.
